answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. What survives to the ridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The vertex holds work receipts rather than names, so the mesa of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
